Server-to-server REST API for Samora AI multilingual voice agents. Trigger outbound calls, manage outbound calling campaigns and their scheduled recipients, and subscribe to real-time call events via webhooks. These APIs are intended for server-to-server integrations; the organization API key must never be exposed in browser or mobile clients.
